advice_items.quote: Follow your gut. If you feel it, take the risk. Step out and do it.
advice_items.summary_en: Follow your gut and take the entrepreneurial leap if you feel it is in you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 相信直觉，果断迈出创业冒险的一步

advice_items.quote: Men and women that consistently hit their sales targets are gold.
advice_items.summary_en: Great salespeople who start at zero each month and consistently hit targets are gold.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售能力至关重要，持续达标者价值连城

advice_items.quote: I do longevity. I work out every day. I eat the right foods, and I'm amazingly good at what I do, staying healthy.
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize longevity by working out daily and eating the right foods.
advice_items.summary_zh: 坚持每日锻炼和健康饮食，保持长寿活力

advice_items.quote: There's only three things you have to get done every day. That's called the signal... The ratio has to be 80% signal, 20% noise.
advice_items.summary_en: Follow Steve Jobs' 80/20 signal-to-noise rule by completing your three core daily priorities and blocking distractions.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天只聚焦三件核心大事，剔除八成干扰

advice_items.quote: I've never met somebody with great wealth who doesn't have great purpose.
advice_items.summary_en: Great wealth stems from having great purpose and deep passion for your business rather than chasing money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 怀抱伟大使命与热爱，财富自然随之而来

guests.first_money_or_break: 创办儿童教育软件公司（致力于提升阅读和数学成绩）起家并获得成功，后成为《创智赢家》常驻投资人。
guests.role_or_title: Shark Tank Investor & Educational Software Founder
guests.zero_start_advice: 精进销售并持续达成业绩目标；运用80%信号与20%噪音法则每天聚焦三件要事；追随直觉勇于承担创业风险。

advice_items.quote: AI. Beyond that, though, we're in the creator economy.
advice_items.summary_en: Master AI and leverage opportunities in the creator economy as the top modern skills.
advice_items.summary_zh: 掌握AI与创作者经济等前沿时代技能

advice_items.quote: Sales. You got to know sales... Good sales people sell a product. Great sales people sell value.
advice_items.summary_en: You must know sales, and great salespeople focus on selling value rather than just a product.
advice_items.summary_zh: 销售要卖价值而非产品，必须精进销售力

advice_items.quote: Constant forward momentum. Every day, there are two or three things that advance the ball. Know what those are.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain constant forward momentum by identifying and executing the two or three daily tasks that move the ball forward.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天识别并推进两三件能推动进展的事

advice_items.quote: There's always a mentor in your life. You just have to listen for it.
advice_items.summary_en: Always stay attentive to mentors around you and internalize wisdom from proven leaders.
advice_items.summary_zh: 人生总有导师出现，关键在于用心倾听

advice_items.quote: Don't chase the money, chase the dream. The money will follow.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on a mission and enjoy the journey rather than chasing money; financial rewards follow passion.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别追逐金钱而要追随使命与梦想，享受过程

guests.first_money_or_break: 创办大型科技公司起家，后成为《创智赢家》知名投资人。
guests.role_or_title: Shark Tank Investor & Tech Company Founder
guests.zero_start_advice: 优先学习AI、创作者经济和价值型销售；每天聚焦推进关键事项并保持前进动量；用心向身边的导师学习，热爱创业过程。

advice_items.quote: I never listen to them. That's why I made it. You can't listen to nobody but yourself and your heart.
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore doubters and listen only to yourself and your own heart.
advice_items.summary_zh: 屏蔽外界质疑声音，只倾听自己内心选择

advice_items.quote: I understood my potential, and I was going to throw the dice, and that's what I did, and I did it a lot of different ways.
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize your potential and be willing to take bold swings across different business ventures.
advice_items.summary_zh: 认清自身潜力后敢于下注，多渠道去闯荡

advice_items.quote: Imagine how many times you've let those $7 walk out of your store over the last 20 years... Somebody else going to get that business.
advice_items.summary_en: Never leave money on the table; close the partial sale today and keep the customer coming back rather than losing business to competitors.
advice_items.summary_zh: 绝不放走任何一笔成交，哪怕先收部分货款

advice_items.quote: I believe in me controlling what I'm best at and whatever my weaknesses are, I'll let someone that's mastered that handle that for you.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on controlling what you do best and delegate your weaknesses to passionate operators who have mastered those areas.
advice_items.summary_zh: 自己只管最擅长的部分，短板交给专家处理

advice_items.quote: Go out there, stick your hand out and introduce yourselves to people and say, 'Yo, man, this what I'm here to do... If you need me, holler at me.'
advice_items.summary_en: Get out of the house, proactively introduce yourself to people, and pitch what you do best.
advice_items.summary_zh: 主动走出家门结识他人，推销自己的能力

advice_items.quote: It's called 'multiples'. Why not? You got to give yourself the opportunity. I don't close the doors on myself. Leave the door open.
advice_items.summary_en: Embrace diversification and build multiple income streams while keeping every opportunity door open.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持收入多元化，不给自己关上任何机会门

advice_items.quote: If you asking if I'm not hustling, you're crazy. And it's Sunday right now and it's going down.
advice_items.summary_en: Enjoy life while never stopping the hustle, even on Sundays.
advice_items.summary_zh: 哪怕周末也不停歇，始终保持高强度拼搏

advice_items.quote: You got to make sure you enjoying life. Don't live and put yourself in a position where you hate what's going on. You got to wake up, feel good about it, go and get it.
advice_items.summary_en: Make sure you enjoy what you do so you wake up excited to pursue your goals.
advice_items.summary_zh: 务必享受生活与事业，别让自己讨厌现状

guests.first_money_or_break: 靠音乐起家，28岁成为百万富翁，随后跨界商业投资，持有30多家Wingstop特许经营店及30余个商业合作项目，累积数亿美元资产。
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要理会质疑者；主动走出去自我推销并抓住每笔交易；专注自身强项并将短板授权给专业人才；多渠道布局收入且保持热忱与拼劲。

advice_items.quote: You aspire to things. You never know where you end up. But, you got to think big.
advice_items.summary_en: Think big and aspire to ambitious goals because you never know how far they can take you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于立下远大志向，格局要足够宏大

advice_items.quote: It's really execution. You know, today everybody has ideas. It's the ability to execute... When you see opportunity, you have to act upon [it].
advice_items.summary_en: Everyone has ideas, but success comes down to executing and acting decisively when you spot an opportunity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 人人都有想法，成败关键在于看到机会就执行

advice_items.quote: They love what they're doing. And I mean, it's not about the money. It's about the love of success, how that makes you feel, and doing things that other people aren't doing.
advice_items.summary_en: Billionaires love what they do and thrive on the impact and fulfillment of achieving what others won't, not just money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 热爱所做之事与成功本身，而非只为金钱

advice_items.quote: It's not all about making money. You're giving back the same time. And if you don't have that feeling of giving back, you lose that fulfillment of having done something.
advice_items.summary_en: Combine making money with giving back and creating real impact so your work remains fulfilling.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在创造财富同时回馈社会，才能获得成就感

advice_items.quote: You got to take risks... I believe in myself and if I fail, not everything works out the way you expect, but you just got to believe overall what you're doing.
advice_items.summary_en: Entrepreneurship requires taking risks without fear and maintaining self-belief even when things don't go as planned.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业必须敢于承担风险，失败了也要相信自己

advice_items.quote: You got to shoot to be the best and you want your organization and people to believe in that... It's about people. You don't do it yourself.
advice_items.summary_en: Aim to be best-in-class and build a united organization of great people, because you cannot scale alone.
advice_items.summary_zh: 追求成为行业顶尖，并依靠优秀团队成事

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: South Florida, I see Palm Beach County, West Palm Beach is probably offering the most amount of opportunity of any place... state of Florida is probably the best business state.
advice_items.summary_en: Operate in high-opportunity, business-friendly markets like South Florida and West Palm Beach.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对高增长且营商环境优越的地区发展

advice_items.quote: Understand yourself, know yourself and then go for it.
advice_items.summary_en: Develop deep self-awareness first, then go after your goals wholeheartedly.
advice_items.summary_zh: 充分认识和了解自己，然后放手去拼搏

guests.first_money_or_break: 白手起家（以1万美元创业且从未拿过外部投资者一分钱），通过房地产开发在35岁左右成为亿万富翁，后收购NFL迈阿密海豚队。
guests.role_or_title: Real Estate Developer & Miami Dolphins Owner
guests.zero_start_advice: 先了解自己，随后立大志并付诸行动；看准机会果断执行，敢于承担风险；瞄准行业一流并组建强大团队，同时兼顾社会影响力与回馈。
